changes: Added COMMAND_POLICIES as the lifecycle source of truth, enforced it as the phaseTools hard ceiling, kept legacy test/fixture commands root-only, updated docs, and added contract checks for lifecycle/doc drift.
usage: Use koala validate --story=<storyId> plus verificationEvidence for current verification. If a blocked legacy command is called, read the lifecycle hint and follow the Replacement path instead of opening phaseTools.
expectedOutcome: Blocked or legacy Koala commands show lifecycle status, allowed phase or root-only state, destructive risk, and replacement guidance; reviewers can inspect planning artifacts; docs no longer describe reviewer lanes as CLI commands.
actualTranscript: test_auto in TEST was blocked with Lifecycle: legacy, Replacement: koala validate --story=<storyId>, Destructive risk: workspace-destructive, and Policy source: command-policy.ts. Runtime probe returned all hard-ceiling booleans true. process-fact contract verified. validate --story=B-5c5e passed with 9/9 verification intent coverage.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap. Expected lifecycle guidance, hard policy ceiling, reviewer-lane wording, and contract guardrails all matched the actual transcript.
pitfalls: Avoid parallel Koala metadata writes: resolving F-006 and F-007 concurrently caused a lost-update style stale status, so sequential metadata commands are safer until write locking is broader.
